subject: Intermittent checkout failures — request for SLO adjudication and telemetry handoff
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@tenfold.com>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.com
Cc: ops@tenfold.com
Date: Fri, 23 Aug 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intermittent checkout failures — quick ask

Hi Soojin,

We saw an acute spike in checkout failures between 08:31 and 08:46 PDT this morning. The error surface on our side looked like authorization timeouts — downstream logs show 500s coming back from your endpoint and a subsequent retry storm that lasted ~15m and bumped our queue depth. Impact: ~4.2% of checkout attempts failed (sampled), two customers opened support tickets.

Can you confirm whether this meets Redwood's SLA downtime conditions? We need: 1) confirmation of the exact service window, 2) a rough eligibility call on pro-rata credits, and 3) a bundle of traces/logs for our compliance team and internal audit.

I attached a short CSV with our observed request ids (tenfold_failures_0823.csv).

Samir
Senior Ops, TenFold

From: soojin.lee@redwood.com
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@tenfold.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 23 Aug 2029 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent checkout failures — quick ask

Samir — thanks for the heads up and the sample ids. We're escalating this now. High-level: we see elevated 5xxs in the auth path in US-WEST-2 during that window; I don't yet have a finalized downtime window or SLA determination.

Next steps from our side:
- I'm collecting the trace sampler bundle (will attach) and the per-instance error breakdown.
- Marcus will do an initial causality check for routing/failover behavior.
- Laura will coordinate with Billing on an initial credit eligibility estimate.

Can you paste the HubSpot deal id you want us to reference and any PO/contract clauses here so we attach the right docs? I will follow up in ~90 minutes with the first artifacts.

— Soojin
Sr. Account Manager, Redwood Inference
From: marcus.lin@redwood.com
To: soojin.lee@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 23 Aug 2029 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent checkout failures — initial findings

Quick note from SRE triage: we sampled the auth service's prometheus metrics and kv cache evictions spike at 08:29:xx, followed by an increase in backend auth latency. Preliminary hypothesis: a short-lived cache miss storm after an infra config rollout that propagated new auth keys to ~12% of hosts. The rollout timeline correlates with the customer's window (08:28–08:33).

I've attached: auth-deployment-diff.patch (small config key rotation change) and a tarball with the sampler traces (trace_sampler_20290823.tar.gz).

Log highlights:
- 08:28:12 PDT: config push started to canary pool (4 hosts)
- 08:28:46 PDT: rollout to 60% of pool begins
- 08:29:04 PDT: KV-cache hit ratio drops from 99.6% to 70% for a 90s period
- 08:29:50 PDT: downstream 500s peak observed in the auth service

We need to validate whether the observed impact meets the contractual "service-unavailable" definition (total auth failures impacting request success) versus an expected transient degradation. I'll keep digging.

Marcus
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: soojin.lee@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@tenfold.com>, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 23 Aug 2029 13:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent checkout failures — credit eligibility prelim

Samir / TenFold — looping you in on the initial eligibility assessment. Based on Marcus's telemetry, the service experienced a measurable availability delta for a ~3 minute high-severity window, with elevated error rates lingering for ~12 minutes total. Under your contract (Section 4.2), Redwood compensates via pro-rata credits for windows that meet "Service Unavailable" thresholds.

Prelim calc: we estimate ~0.05% SLA impact averaged across your monthly traffic for the window in question. That maps to a single-month credit equivalent to ~0.5% of that month's invoice per our pro-rata formula. I'm attaching a working spreadsheet SLO_Credit_Calc_20290823.xlsx with the assumptions and raw numbers.

Before we finalize:
- We need the full list of affected request ids (you supplied a CSV — thanks).
- Confirm whether TenFold prefers an immediate one-off credit or to discuss rolling accommodations (extended trial, invoice offset).

Grace, can you prepare a short post-incident timeline and proposed remediation steps we can share externally? We should also ask Legal whether this is a contractual remediation or an operational goodwill gesture.

Thanks,
Laura
Billing Ops, Redwood Inference
From: soojin.lee@redwood.com
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@tenfold.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 23 Aug 2029 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent checkout failures — next steps and postmortem request

Samir — appreciate the patience. To summarize and propose an immediate path forward:

1) Downtime window: Our current evidence aligns impact to 08:29:04–08:32:10 PDT as the primary high-severity interval, with elevated errors tapering through 08:41:00. We will include the exact host-level traces in the bundle.

2) Credit eligibility: Laura's preliminary calc (attached) shows this meets the contract threshold for a pro-rata credit. We will not finalize the amount until you confirm the affected request id list and whether you prefer the credit applied to next invoice or as a separate adjustment.

3) Postmortem & remediation: Grace will draft an externally-facing timeline and planned remediation (deploy gating for key rotations, improved canary invariants, and a small KV-cache warmup during rollout). We propose a joint postmortem call early next week to walk TenFold through the timeline and the remediation plan.

Attachments included: trace_sampler_20290823.tar.gz; auth-deployment-diff.patch; SLO_Credit_Calc_20290823.xlsx

Would Monday 10:00 PDT work for a 30-minute review? If so, we'll send a calendar invite and a short pre-read.

— Soojin
Sr. Account Manager, Redwood Inference
